title: Price-history ingestion
prompt: Specify the price-history ingestion module for arbitrary equity/crypto tickers: bar schema, caching, rate-limit handling and acceptance tests.

title: Rule-engine contract for five mechanical rules
prompt: Specify one rule-engine contract that five mechanical trading rules implement: rule interface, parameter contract, signal record, deterministic evaluation and acceptance tests.

title: Walk-forward runner with in/out-of-sample split
prompt: Specify a walk-forward runner for one rule: window schedule, in-sample/out-of-sample split, result record and compute bound per run.

title: Comparison against buy-and-hold
prompt: Specify a comparison of rule results against buy-and-hold on the same ticker and window: benchmark definition, metric set, data contract and acceptance tests.

title: Parameter optimizer with out-of-sample selection
prompt: Specify a parameter optimizer that selects parameters on out-of-sample performance only: search space, out-of-sample selection rule, result cache and compute bound.

title: Results presentation for a retail trader
prompt: Specify how backtest results are presented to a self-directed retail trader: plain-language summary, metric explanations, risk disclosure and acceptance tests.
